# James Fox

> Personal website of James Fox, a full-stack software developer and Senior AI Applied Innovation Specialist in AstraZeneca's Enterprise AI team, based in Cambridge, UK.

The linked pages contain James's own descriptions of his work and interests. This is a personal portfolio, not an official website for any company named. The pages provide their main content as static HTML.

## Biography and projects

- [About James](https://james-fox.com/#whoami): Background in pharmaceutical R&D software, bioinformatics and applied AI, plus personal interests.
- [Experience and CV](https://james-fox.com/experience/): Career history at AstraZeneca and GSK, education and technical skills.
- [Download James's CV (PDF)](https://james-fox.com/assets/documents/james-fox-cv.pdf): James's CV, with direct contact details removed for public sharing.
- [Projects](https://james-fox.com/projects/): Project write-ups describing James's contributions and outcomes.
- [RNAopt](https://james-fox.com/projects/#rnaopt): mRNA sequence optimisation software, batch processing, APIs and multi-objective optimisation. Some details are not public.
- [Home lab](https://james-fox.com/projects/#home-lab): Ubuntu, Docker Compose, Wiki.js, PostgreSQL and self-hosted tools, with plans to expand documentation and automation.
- [AI discovery](https://james-fox.com/projects/#rag-discovery): A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) tool for discovering projects and expertise across AstraZeneca.

## Public profiles

- [Contact](https://james-fox.com/contact/): Public profile links and a Cloudflare-verified reveal for direct contact details.
